tools.name: narrated_video_plan

tools.description: Run `python -m narrate video plan --json` on one job in the narrated-video store: the admit gate (narrate job and script digest, consent and revocation, persona label, bed record and its acquisition by the operator, tighten on synthetic narration, knob bounds, the kitpip pin, Edition.check at Plan), then one stage key, state and reason per node of the 13-stage graph (fresh, stale, corrupt, blocked, refused, not_selected or pending_operator), the nodes ready to run and the operator gates still open. tools.name: avatar_overlay
tools.title: Render the avatar overlay
tools.description: Run the avatar stage of one job (`python -m narrate video stage JOB avatar --segment ID --json`). The job's avatar.external picks the implementation: kitpip (the default and the current one) or vrm (a draft, SPR-128). The tool name stays the same when a job moves from kitpip to vrm, so the DAG (program/dags/narrated-video.json), a catalog row and a guard record that name it keep that name across the swap. With kitpip: resolve KITPIP_BIN against the private pin, then run kitpip `analyze` on the segment's narrate run at the base's frame rate, `render` a ProRes 4444 overlay at renderSize and `verify` it, all inside the stage's partial directory in the job store, never inside the narrate run or under artifacts/runs/. Relays kitpip's own refusal codes (no_consent, not_synthetic, digest_mismatch, contract_invalid, inside_narration_run, would_overwrite_input, unknown_rig) and adds kitpip_missing, kitpip_pin_pending, kitpip_pin_mismatch, kitpip_unlabelled, label_chain_broken and avatar_outside_store. Never passes --allow-unlabelled-test, --pipe or --badge. The stage key holds the binary digest, the rig and its revision, renderSize, the persona and the narration digest. With vrm: check the model's likeness consent (SP-R13: the consents.json row its likenessConsent.id names, with the Likeness scope, granted by the operator), appearance approval (TIN-7130), open badge decision and Internal edition, resolve VRM_RENDERER_BIN against the private pin, build face.json (face.timeline/v1) from the segment's narrate run at the base's frame rate, run the renderer (three-vrm in headless Chromium stepping vrm.update(1/fps) per frame) on the model from the private store, stream its raw RGBA frames into a ProRes 4444 overlay and write an avatar.manifest/v1 with the model digest, the VRM meta licence fields, the renderer, the pinned engine kind and lock digest, the reported frame step (refused unless it is {num, den} equal to 1/fps and the engine kind is the pin's), the GPU and driver and frames_identity per_host. Everything lands in the stage's partial directory in the job store, never inside the narrate run or under artifacts/runs/. Refuses vrm_model_missing, vrm_model_invalid, vrm_digest_mismatch, vrm_consent_missing, vrm_consent_revoked, vrm_approval_missing, vrm_badge_undecided, vrm_edition_unruled, vrm_pin_pending, vrm_pin_mismatch, vrm_renderer_missing, vrm_invalid, vrm_meta_missing, vrm_frames_mismatch, vrm_report_invalid, face_timeline_invalid and avatar_outside_store, and relays the renderer's own codes. Never passes --badge or --realtime. Speech workflow, not a guitar default: the guitar axioms in AGENTS.md do not apply; the overlay manifest says no_time_stretch false with the non-identity mapping avatar_overlay_v1, so no guitar tool accepts it (docs/spec/TIMELINE_CONTRACT.md).
tools.intent: Let an agent render the narrator overlay for each segment from its consented narration, with the avatar external the job names, bound to a pinned binary by digest.

tools.name: narrated_video_mix
tools.title: Mix voice and bed
tools.description: Run the mix stage of one job (`python -m narrate video stage JOB mix --json`): re-measure the placed voice (it must sit within driftLu of targetLufs; nothing loudness-normalises it), set the bed bedBelowVoiceLu under the measured voice, duck it duckDb under the foreground (Sidechain on voice plus kept clip sound, or EdlEnvelope on the placed spans) with attackMs and releaseMs ramps, fade it fadeInS in and fadeOutS out, sum, and run one limiter 0.5 dB under truePeakDbtp. Measures the mix: drift over driftLu refuses loudness_drift and a true peak above truePeakDbtp refuses true_peak_exceeded. Writes mix.wav, bed-ducked.wav and mix.json with the measured loudness, true peak, bed gain and applied duck depth. tools.title: Compose a narrated video
tools.description: Run the compose stage of one job (`python -m narrate video stage JOB compose --json`) and, with handoff true, the handoff stage: scale the base to the delivery profile (Web1080p30, Talk or Contingency), lay on the slide pages (layout Full or CardLowerLeft: a lower-left card over the held next-clip frame dimmed to dimTo, fades and in-place crossfades over fadeS) and each segment's kitpip overlay (ProRes 4444, straight alpha) at its corner from the segment start, hidden with fades over every page avatarOff lists, then encode video.mp4 (H.264 yuv420p, AAC 48 kHz, soft captions) and video.upload.mp4. Writes captions.srt and captions.vtt from the narrate runs' cues on the base clock, description.txt from a fixed template, chapters.json and compose.json. Handoff writes layers/ (bare base, overlays, slide pictures, stems, captions) and edit.json with every input's stage key. Refuses captions_burn_unsupported, captions_missing, slides_exceed_program, overlay_exceeds_base, frames_mismatch and label_chain_broken. Speech workflow, not a guitar default: the guitar axioms in AGENTS.md do not apply; every stage manifest that carries narration, an overlay or a bed says no_time_stretch false with a non-identity mapping (narration_v1, narrated_video_v1, avatar_overlay_v1 or music_bed_v1), so no guitar tool accepts it (docs/spec/TIMELINE_CONTRACT.md).

tools.name: narrated_video_verify
tools.title: Check delivery gates
tools.description: Run the deliver_check stage of one job (`python -m narrate video stage JOB deliver_check --json`): probe video.mp4 against its profile (codec, pixel format, size, rate, channels, frames, caption track), measure the delivered loudness and true peak, measure the flash gate at every slide change (the largest adjacent-frame mean-luma jump, at most 30%), check the captions, persona cue and description notice, and report the operator gates (listening, lip sync, and with upload and a bed the licence PDF digest and Content ID) as pending_operator. Writes deliver_check.json with per-gate states and delivery_gate (internal_review_allowed, upload_gates_closed, public_upload_allowed; the last stays false while any operator state is pending, so deliver_check never reports it true). A failed machine gate is a state; the stage refuses only edition_voice_refused, edition_pip_refused or edition_bed_refused at DeliverCheck and label_chain_broken. Never uploads or publishes. tools.name: narrated_video_intake
tools.title: Take in a demo bundle
tools.description: Run `python -m narrate video intake BUNDLE --out DIR --json`: parse the bundle strictly, hash every asset against its manifest sha256, run the private-terms guard when the manifest declares ip_private or never_name (every record text, voiced text, claim text, persona label and, after the pronunciation tables, every spoken form is checked against the denylist the manifest binds by sha256), run the spoken-number claims gate on every beat, convert the bundle to one NarratedVideo job (edition Internal, one segment per beat anchored at its start, PNG beats as Full slide pages by sha256, one MP4 as the base video, otherwise the default card) and one confidential narrate job per beat (Markdown input over the voiced text, inputSha256 bound, allowHosted false, voice and engine from the arguments, the rest copied from a template narrate job), check the job with admit, check that the template's pronunciation tables add no spoken number, and only then write narrated-video.json, records/ (the input renders plus the new narrate jobs), intake.json (per-segment spans, assets, receipts and claims results) and the beat scripts and cited assets into the store by digest. Every store target is checked before anything is written, each asset copy is opened without following a symlink and re-hashed against its manifest sha256, and the output is built in a temporary sibling and renamed into place. Refuses with a typed code and leaves no output and no new store file on any failure: bundle_invalid, asset_missing, asset_digest_mismatch, asset_kind_mismatch, asset_unreceipted, asset_unknown, asset_needs_conversion (a beat cites a GIF; no stage reads GIF), asset_video_multiple, script_invalid, beat_invalid, beat_voiced_missing, voiced_not_verbatim, claim_invalid, claim_unknown, the claims-gate codes number_unclaimed, claim_unreceipted, claim_ambiguous and number_ambiguous (with the per-segment report), the template, voice and engine codes, pronunciation_unknown, pronunciation_refused, pronunciation_adds_number, lexical_missing, lexical_digest_mismatch, denylist_missing, denylist_misplaced, denylist_digest_mismatch, denylist_invalid, denylist_pin_invalid, privacy_undeclared, private_term, out_exists, store_conflict, narrate_job_exists and admit's codes. Renders nothing, starts no engine and publishes nothing. Results carry ids, digests and the claims report; intake.json names the bundle by slug and digests, never by path. Speech workflow, not a guitar default: the guitar axioms in AGENTS.md do not apply. The intake renders nothing and writes no media manifest; the job it writes runs through the stages above, whose manifests say no_time_stretch false with a non-identity mapping (docs/spec/TIMELINE_CONTRACT.md).
tools.intent: Let an agent turn a receipt-backed demo bundle into a narrated-video job without speaking a number no receipt backs.

bundle.description: The demo bundle directory: manifest.json, script.md, claims.json and the assets the manifest lists (docs/spec/NARRATED_VIDEO.md, "Demo bundle intake"). It lives in its producer's private repository; no symlink component.

out.description: A new or empty directory for narrated-video.json, records/ and intake.json. Never under artifacts/runs/.

records.description: A directory of dhall-to-json renders: jobs.json (holding the template narrate job), voices.json, consents.json, engines.json and, optionally, pronunciation.json and music-beds.json.

store.description: The private store that receives each beat's Markdown and each cited asset as <sha256><suffix> (default out/store).

job.description: The job id (default the bundle directory's name): 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-'. Each narrate job is <job>-<beat>.

narrate_template.description: A narrate job record id whose lexical pin, pronunciation table, scope, gates and post settings every beat's narrate job copies.

voice.description: The voice record id every beat reads in. Its consent is checked by admit; never a clip or a path.

engine.description: The engine record id. It must admit a confidential job (Engine.mayRunConfidential): no hosted engine.

persona.description: Turn the kitpip avatar on with this labels.persona. Exactly one of persona and no_avatar.

tail_s.description: Seconds a card base holds after the last narration (default 1).

denylist.description: The private denylist file (kind nv_denylist) that the manifest's privacy block binds by sha256. Required when the manifest declares ip_private or never_name; missing, unbound or malformed refuses (docs/spec/NARRATED_VIDEO.md, "Private terms"). It lives outside the bundle and outside git; no symlink.

denylist_sha256.description: The operator's pinned sha256 of the denylist (or NARRATED_VIDEO_DENYLIST_SHA256). It marks the lane private: an undeclared bundle refuses privacy_undeclared and the file must hash to the pin whatever the manifest binds (docs/spec/NARRATED_VIDEO.md, "Private terms").

timeout_seconds.description: Outer deadline for the whole call in seconds (at most 900). A timed-out intake has written nothing, or only its complete output; call it again with a new out directory.

limitations: The claims gate reads English digits and number words and a fixed unit table; it checks that a cited claim names a receipt, not what the receipt says.
One MP4 per bundle becomes the base video and plays from program second 0 under every beat; GIF assets refuse until the producer converts them.
A converted job is checked by admit only; its narration, placement and delivery are measured by the stage tools, and listening stays an operator state.
The private-terms guard reads text only and over-matches on purpose; a paraphrase, a translation, leetspeak, slide pixels, video frames and asset metadata pass it and stay with producer review.

dependencies.note: intake runs the claims gate itself; narrated_video_claims shows the report without writing. narrated_video_plan follows once the job is initialised from narrated-video.json.

agent_workflow.identify: Read the refusal code and the per-segment claims report, or intake.json's segments, unused_assets and admit verdict.
agent_workflow.research: docs/spec/NARRATED_VIDEO.md "Demo bundle intake"; the bundle's own receipts in its producer's repository.
agent_workflow.iterate: Fix the bundle in its producer's repository (reword a number, cite or add a receipted claim, convert a GIF), then rerun claims and intake into a new out directory and compare the reports.
agent_workflow.acceptance: A passed intake is a source check. Render, listening and delivery are later, separate states.

tools.name: narrated_video_claims
tools.title: Check a demo bundle's spoken numbers
tools.description: Run `python -m narrate video claims BUNDLE`: read script.md, claims.json and the manifest's privacy block only. When the manifest declares ip_private or never_name, first run the private-terms guard against the denylist it binds by sha256 (missing, misplaced, unbound or malformed refuses denylist_missing, denylist_misplaced, denylist_digest_mismatch or denylist_invalid; a match refuses private_term with a report of positions, entry positions and classes, never an entry id or the matched text). Then extract every number each beat's voiced text speaks (digits, spelled-out cardinals, decimals such as 'seventeen point eight seven seven', ordinals, percentages and the unit words after them) and match each to exactly one claim the beat cites with the same exact decimal value and canonical unit and a non-empty receipt. Returns {ok, bundle (script and claims digests), segments: [{segment, status, codes, mentions, unused_claims}], private_terms: {status, ip_private, never_name, denylist_sha256, entries, checked, matches}}; each mention carries its text, number, unit, kind and either the matched claim and receipt or a code (number_unclaimed, claim_unreceipted, claim_ambiguous, number_ambiguous with a reason). Fails closed on ambiguity: adjacent number words, fractions and vague quantities (including 'a third', plural scale words and '-fold' words), a scale word with no count, 'point' with no whole part, 'second' as ordinal or unit, Roman numerals, a dash between number words, a decade such as '90s', a scale abbreviation or unknown unit symbol after a number ('17 K', 'bn', 'GiB') and digit tokens that are not one plain number (including any non-ASCII numeral) never match. Refuses bundle_invalid, script_invalid, beat_invalid, beat_voiced_missing, claim_invalid and claim_unknown before the gate runs. Reads no records, so it does not check the pronunciation tables; narrated_video_intake does. Read-only: writes nothing and renders nothing. Speech workflow, not a guitar default: the guitar axioms in AGENTS.md do not apply.
tools.intent: Let an agent see which spoken numbers in a demo script lack a receipt before any intake or render.

bundle.description: The demo bundle directory: manifest.json, script.md, claims.json and the assets the manifest lists (docs/spec/NARRATED_VIDEO.md, "Demo bundle intake"). It lives in its producer's private repository; no symlink component.

denylist.description: The private denylist file (kind nv_denylist) that the manifest's privacy block binds by sha256. Required when the manifest declares ip_private or never_name; missing, unbound or malformed refuses (docs/spec/NARRATED_VIDEO.md, "Private terms"). It lives outside the bundle and outside git; no symlink.

denylist_sha256.description: The operator's pinned sha256 of the denylist (or NARRATED_VIDEO_DENYLIST_SHA256). It marks the lane private: an undeclared bundle refuses privacy_undeclared and the file must hash to the pin whatever the manifest binds (docs/spec/NARRATED_VIDEO.md, "Private terms").

timeout_seconds.description: Outer deadline for the whole call in seconds (at most 900). The gate is read-only, so a timed-out call has changed nothing; call it again.

limitations: English number words and the unit table in the spec only; a number in another language or an unknown unit reads as a bare count or not at all.
'one', 'first' and 'second' are always numbers: a script that uses them as ordinary words cites a claim or rewords.
The private-terms guard reads text only and over-matches on purpose; a paraphrase, a translation, leetspeak, slide pixels, video frames and asset metadata pass it and stay with producer review.

agent_workflow.identify: Read each refused mention's code and reason, and each segment's unused_claims.
agent_workflow.research: The claim's receipt in the bundle producer's repository; docs/spec/NARRATED_VIDEO.md "Claims gate".
agent_workflow.iterate: Reword or cite, rerun, and compare the two reports segment by segment.
agent_workflow.acceptance: Every segment passed. A passed gate says each number names a receipt, not that the receipt is right.
